lead.en: Every paper, clustered by category. For orientation only; use the views above to read.
lead.zh: 全部论文按分类聚在一起，只用来看轮廓；细读请用上面的视图。

nodes.label: Generalized OOD survey
nodes.title: Generalized Out-of-Distribution Detection: A Survey

oneliner.en: Unifies five separately developed sub-fields — anomaly detection (AD), novelty detection (ND), open-set recognition (OSR), OOD detection and outlier detection (OD) — into one "generalized OOD detection" framework, distinguishing them along four dichotomies (covariate vs semantic shift, single- vs multi-class ID, whether ID classification is required, inductive vs transductive); systematically reviews OOD methods (classifier outputs, Outlier Exposure, gradients, Bayesian, foundation models, density, distance, reconstruction), runs a unified fair comparison on OpenOOD, and lays out challenges and future directions.
oneliner.zh: 把异常检测(AD)、新颖性检测(ND)、开集识别(OSR)、OOD 检测和离群检测(OD)五个各自发展的子领域统一进一个「广义 OOD 检测」框架,用四个二分维度(检测协变量偏移还是语义偏移、ID 是单类还是多类、是否需要 ID 分类、归纳还是直推)厘清它们的区别;系统综述 OOD 检测方法(分类器输出、Outlier Exposure、梯度、贝叶斯、基础模型、密度、距离、重构),在 OpenOOD 上做统一公平对比,并列出挑战与未来方向。

nodes.label: Conformal p-values
nodes.title: Testing for Outliers with Conformal p-values

oneliner.en: Turns the output of any one-class classifier / anomaly scorer into a p-value per test point via split-conformal calibration, and studies these p-values from a multiple-testing perspective: classical (marginal) conformal p-values are mutually dependent but PRDS, so Benjamini–Hochberg (even with Storey's correction) still controls the FDR exactly, while Fisher's combination test breaks; it then constructs calibration-conditionally valid (CCV) p-values — valid with probability 1−δ for *this* calibration set and mutually independent — and, as a by-product, a simultaneous upper confidence bound on the FPR of any outlier-detection algorithm.
oneliner.zh: 把任意一类分类器 / 异常打分器的输出,经 split-conformal 校准变成每个测试点的 p 值,并从多重检验角度研究它们:证明经典(边际)conformal p 值虽然彼此相关,但满足 PRDS,因此 Benjamini–Hochberg(含 Storey 修正)仍精确控制 FDR,而 Fisher 合并检验会失效;再提出校准条件有效(calibration-conditional valid, CCV)的 p 值——以概率 1−δ 对「这一份」校准集有效,且彼此独立——并顺带给出任意异常检测算法 FPR 的同时置信上界。

nodes.label: PatchCore
nodes.title: Towards Total Recall in Industrial Anomaly Detection
nodes.venue: 2022 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

oneliner.en: PatchCore stores mid-level, neighbourhood-aggregated patch features of all normal training images in a memory bank, shrinks it to 1–25% with greedy coreset subsampling at almost no loss, and scores a test image by the distance of its most anomalous patch to that patch's nearest normal neighbour — 99.1% image AUROC on MVTec AD (up to 99.6% with an ensemble), more than halving PaDiM's error.
oneliner.zh: PatchCore 把所有正常训练图像的中层、局部邻域聚合的 patch 特征存进一个 memory bank,用 greedy coreset 子采样把它压缩到 1–25% 而几乎不掉性能,测试时以"最远的那个 patch 到其最近正常邻居的距离"作为图像异常分数;在 MVTec AD 上图像级 AUROC 99.1%(集成可达 99.6%),把 PaDiM 的误差减半以上。

nodes.label: Unifying AD review
nodes.title: A Unifying Review of Deep and Shallow Anomaly Detection

oneliner.en: This review (TU Berlin / Kloft / Dietterich / Müller groups) unifies anomaly detection under a probabilistic definition (an anomaly is a point in a low-density region of the normal law P⁺; the problem is density level-set estimation) and a five-dimension modelling framework (loss, model, feature map, regularisation, inference mode), pairing classic "shallow" and deep methods across three families — probabilistic/density, one-class classification, reconstruction. A common benchmark on MNIST-C and MVTec-AD plus XAI explanations shows there is no silver bullet — and that a high AUC can be a Clever Hans effect driven by spurious correlations.
oneliner.zh: 这篇综述(TU Berlin / Kloft / Dietterich / Müller 组)把异常检测统一到一个概率定义(异常 = 正常分布 P⁺ 低密度区的点,问题即密度水平集估计)和一个五维建模框架(损失、模型、特征映射、正则、推断方式)之下,把经典"浅层"方法与深度方法按三大族——概率/密度、单类分类、重建——一一对应;再用 MNIST-C 与 MVTec-AD 的统一实验与 XAI 解释表明:没有银弹,而且高 AUC 可能是 Clever Hans(靠虚假相关取得)。

nodes.label: f-AnoGAN
nodes.title: f-AnoGAN: Fast unsupervised anomaly detection with generative adversarial networks

oneliner.en: f-AnoGAN replaces AnoGAN's per-image iterative latent search with a trained encoder E: train a WGAN-GP on healthy OCT patches, then freeze G and D and train E with a "pixel residual + discriminator-feature residual" objective (izi_f); at test time one forward pass gives the reconstruction G(E(x)) and the anomaly score. Image-level AUC is 0.930, beating AE / AdvAE / ALI and iterative AnoGAN (0.911), while inference drops from 2 days to 20 seconds.
oneliner.zh: f-AnoGAN 把 AnoGAN 的"每张图 latent 迭代搜索"换成一个训练好的编码器 E:先在健康 OCT 图块上训练 WGAN-GP,再固定 G 和 D、用"像素残差 + 判别器特征残差"(izi_f)训练 E,测试时一次前向即得重建 G(E(x)) 与异常分数;图像级 AUC 0.930,优于 AE / AdvAE / ALI 与迭代式 AnoGAN(0.911),而推理从 2 天缩到 20 秒。

nodes.label: Deep SVDD
nodes.title: Deep One-Class Classification
nodes.venue: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2018), PMLR 80

oneliner.en: Deep SVDD is, per the authors, the first deep method trained directly on an anomaly-detection objective: a network φ is trained so that normal data's representations fall into a minimum-volume hypersphere around a fixed centre c, and the test-time anomaly score is ‖φ(x) − c‖². The paper also proves which design choices cause "hypersphere collapse" (bias terms, bounded activations, a learnable centre) and the ν-property of the soft-boundary variant.
oneliner.zh: Deep SVDD 是第一个直接以异常检测为目标训练的深度方法(作者自述):训练一个神经网络 φ,让正常数据的表示尽量落进一个以固定中心 c 为圆心、体积最小的超球,测试时异常分数就是 ‖φ(x) − c‖²;论文同时证明了哪些网络设计会导致"超球坍缩"(偏置项、有界激活、可学习的中心),以及软边界版本的 ν-性质。

nodes.label: Mahalanobis OOD
nodes.title: A Simple Unified Framework for Detecting Out-of-Distribution Samples and Adversarial Attacks
nodes.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 31 (NeurIPS 2018)

oneliner.en: Without retraining a pre-trained softmax classifier, fit class-conditional Gaussians with a tied covariance (GDA/LDA) in its feature space and use the Mahalanobis distance of a test sample to the closest class mean as the confidence score; with input pre-processing and a multi-layer feature ensemble, the same score reached state of the art on both OOD and adversarial-sample detection, was more robust to noisy labels and small training sets, and enabled training-free class-incremental learning.
oneliner.zh: 不重新训练任何预训练 softmax 分类器,在它的特征空间里为每一类拟合共享协方差的类条件高斯(即 GDA/LDA),用测试样本到最近类均值的 Mahalanobis 距离作为置信分数;再加上输入预处理与多层特征集成,同一个分数同时在 OOD 检测和对抗样本检测上达到当时最优,对噪声标签和小样本训练集更稳健,还能免训练地做类增量学习。

nodes.label: CFLOW-AD
nodes.title: CFLOW-AD: Real-Time Unsupervised Anomaly Detection with Localization via Conditional Normalizing Flows
nodes.venue: 2022 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)

oneliner.en: CFLOW-AD trains, for each scale of an ImageNet-pretrained CNN encoder, a normalizing-flow decoder conditioned on positional encoding that estimates the exact log-likelihood of each patch feature as the anomaly score. The authors show that under a multivariate-Gaussian prior the flow objective reduces to the Mahalanobis distance (so PaDiM is a special case), and CFLOW-AD reaches 98.26% detection AUROC, 98.62% localization AUROC and 94.60% AUPRO on MVTec while being ~10× faster and smaller than PaDiM/SPADE in the same setting.
oneliner.zh: CFLOW-AD 在 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 编码器的多尺度特征上,为每个尺度训练一个以位置编码为条件的 normalizing flow 解码器,直接估计每个 patch 特征的精确对数似然作为异常分数;作者证明在多元高斯先验下 flow 目标退化为 Mahalanobis 距离(即 PaDiM 是其特例),而 CFLOW-AD 在 MVTec 上达到 98.26% 检测 AUROC、98.62% 定位 AUROC、94.60% AUPRO,并比同设置的 PaDiM/SPADE 快且小约 10 倍。

nodes.label: Diffusion AD (medical)
nodes.title: Diffusion Models for Medical Anomaly Detection
nodes.venue: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2022), LNCS 13438

oneliner.en: DDIM's deterministic noising encodes a patient image to noise level L; denoising with classifier guidance then "translates" it to the healthy class, and the difference between input and output is a pixel-level anomaly map — a weakly supervised AD method needing only image-level (healthy/diseased) labels, described by the authors as the first diffusion model for anomaly detection.
oneliner.zh: 用 DDIM 的确定性加噪把病人图像编码到噪声水平 L,再在去噪时加分类器引导把它"翻译"成健康类,输入与生成图之差就是像素级异常图 —— 一个只需图像级标签(健康/患病)的弱监督异常检测方法,作者称是首个用于异常检测的扩散模型。

nodes.label: DRAEM
nodes.title: DRÆM – A discriminatively trained reconstruction embedding for surface anomaly detection
nodes.venue: 2021 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)

oneliner.en: DRÆM recasts surface anomaly detection from "learn normal only, read the reconstruction error" into a discriminative problem: it pastes "just-out-of-distribution" synthetic anomalies onto normal images (Perlin-noise masks + external textures) and jointly trains a reconstructive sub-network that inpaints them back to normal and a discriminative sub-network that reads "original ⊕ reconstruction" and outputs a pixel-level anomaly map — 98.0% image AUROC and 68.4% pixel AP on MVTec AD, +2.5 and +13.4 points over the previous best.
oneliner.zh: DRÆM 把表面异常检测从"只学正常、看重建误差"改成判别问题:在正常图像上用 Perlin 噪声 mask + 外部纹理贴出"刚好越界(just-out-of-distribution)"的合成异常,同时训练一个把异常修复回正常的重建子网络和一个读取"原图 ⊕ 重建图"并输出像素级异常图的判别子网络;MVTec AD 图像级 AUROC 98.0%、像素 AP 68.4%,比此前最好方法分别高 2.5 和 13.4 个百分点。

nodes.label: PaDiM
nodes.title: PaDiM: A Patch Distribution Modeling Framework for Anomaly Detection and Localization
nodes.venue: Pattern Recognition. ICPR International Workshops and Challenges (ICPR 2020 Workshops), LNCS 12664

oneliner.en: PaDiM trains no network at all: it embeds every patch position with multi-layer features from an ImageNet-pretrained CNN, fits one multivariate Gaussian N(μ_ij, Σ_ij) per position over the normal training images, and at test time scores each patch by its Mahalanobis distance to produce an anomaly map — reaching 97.5% pixel AUROC / 92.1% PRO on MVTec AD with inference cost independent of training-set size.
oneliner.zh: PaDiM 不训练任何网络:用 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 的多层特征给每个 patch 位置做 embedding,在每个位置上对正常训练图像拟合一个多元高斯 N(μ_ij, Σ_ij),测试时用 Mahalanobis 距离作为 patch 级异常分数,得到异常图;在 MVTec AD 上做到 97.5% 像素级 AUROC / 92.1% PRO,且推理成本与训练集大小无关。

nodes.label: Energy OOD
nodes.title: Energy-based Out-of-distribution Detection
nodes.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33 (NeurIPS 2020)

oneliner.en: Interpret a classifier's logits as an energy-based model: the free energy E(x) = −T·logsumexp(f(x)/T) is aligned with input density, whereas log-MSP is just the energy of "logits minus the max logit", a biased score. So replace softmax confidence with energy — no training, no hyperparameters — and average FPR95 on CIFAR-10 drops by 18.03%; with auxiliary outlier data, energy-bounded fine-tuning with two squared hinge losses widens the ID/OOD energy gap and beats Outlier Exposure.
oneliner.zh: 把分类器的 logit 解释为能量模型:free energy E(x) = −T·logsumexp(f(x)/T) 与输入密度对齐,而 log MSP 只是「logit 减去最大 logit」后的 energy,是一个有偏分数;因此直接用 energy 替代 softmax 置信度——不需训练、无超参——就能在 CIFAR-10 上把平均 FPR95 降低 18.03%;若有辅助离群数据,再用两条 squared hinge 损失做 energy-bounded 微调,拉开 ID 与 OOD 的能量差,超过 Outlier Exposure。

nodes.label: MVTec AD
nodes.title: MVTec AD — A Comprehensive Real-World Dataset for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
nodes.venue: 2019 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

oneliner.en: MVTec AD is the first unsupervised anomaly-detection dataset aimed at real industrial inspection with multiple objects, multiple defect types and pixel-precise ground truth: 15 categories (5 textures + 10 objects), 5,354 high-resolution images, 73 defect types and 1,888 hand-annotated anomalous regions, with defect-free images only in training. The paper also benchmarks AnoGAN, L2/SSIM autoencoders, a CNN feature dictionary, a GMM texture model and a variation model, concluding that no method works well on every category. It became the standard benchmark for virtually all visual AD methods since, including PaDiM, PatchCore, DRÆM and CFLOW-AD.
oneliner.zh: MVTec AD 是第一个面向真实工业检测、多物体、多缺陷、带像素级真值的无监督异常检测数据集:15 个类别(5 纹理 + 10 物体)、5,354 张高分辨率图像、73 种缺陷、1,888 个手工标注的异常区域;训练集只含无缺陷图像。论文同时给出 AnoGAN、L2/SSIM 自编码器、CNN 特征字典、GMM 纹理模型、variation model 的初始基准,结论是没有一种方法在所有类别上都好。它此后成为 PaDiM、PatchCore、DRÆM、CFLOW-AD 等几乎所有视觉 AD 方法的标准评测集。

nodes.label: AnoGAN
nodes.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection with Generative Adversarial Networks to Guide Marker Discovery
nodes.venue: Information Processing in Medical Imaging (IPMI 2017), LNCS 10265

oneliner.en: AnoGAN trains a DCGAN only on healthy retinal OCT patches; at test time it runs 500 gradient-descent steps in latent space to find the "most similar normal image" G(z) for each new patch, and scores anomalies by a weighted sum of a pixel residual and a residual on intermediate discriminator features, with the residual image serving as the anomaly map. Per the authors it is the first use of GANs for anomaly detection, and it founds the "learn normal → reconstruct → read the residual" paradigm.
oneliner.zh: AnoGAN 只在健康视网膜 OCT 图块上训练一个 DCGAN,测试时对每张新图块在 latent space 里做 500 步梯度下降找到"最像它的正常图像" G(z),用像素残差 + 判别器中间层特征残差的加权和作异常分数、残差图作异常定位 —— 这是把 GAN 用于异常检测的首个工作(作者自述),也是"学正常 → 重建 → 看残差"这一范式的奠基论文。

nodes.label: MSP baseline
nodes.title: A Baseline for Detecting Misclassified and Out-of-Distribution Examples in Neural Networks

oneliner.en: The founding paper of OOD detection: a trained classifier's maximum softmax probability (MSP) is not a usable confidence on its own (an MNIST classifier assigns 91% "confidence" to Gaussian noise), but correctly classified examples have statistically higher MSP than misclassified and out-of-distribution ones, so thresholding MSP detects errors and OOD inputs across vision, NLP and speech. The authors also define standard tasks and metrics (AUROC plus two AUPRs) and show with an "auxiliary decoder + abnormality module" that the baseline can be beaten.
oneliner.zh: OOD 检测领域的起点论文:训练好的分类器给出的最大 softmax 概率(MSP)本身不能当作置信度(MNIST 分类器对高斯噪声也给出 91% 的「置信度」),但正确分类样本的 MSP 统计上高于错分样本和分布外样本,所以把 MSP 当阈值分数,就能在视觉、NLP、语音任务上检出错误和 OOD;作者同时定义了一套标准任务与指标(AUROC + 两种 AUPR),并用一个「辅助解码器 + 异常模块」说明这个基线可以被超越。

nodes.label: Damage scores
nodes.title: Cell-type-specific damage scores reveal kidney and liver disease trajectories in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics

oneliner.en: A general framework of cell-type-specific continuous damage scores that place individual cells on a health-to-damage axis: 42 genes with consistent changes across many mouse disease models are scored with AUCell, giving the podocyte damage score PDS (CKD/FSGS) and hepatocyte damage score HDS (MASLD/NASH); across mouse and human scRNA, snRNA, spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, histology and clinical data they detect disease-associated damage, align different disease models, and resolve damage variation even among unperturbed control cells.
oneliner.zh: 提出一个通用框架,用细胞类型特异的连续损伤分数把单个细胞放在"健康 → 损伤"轴上:从大量小鼠疾病模型中挑出一致变化的 42 个基因,用 AUCell 打分,得到足细胞损伤分数 PDS(CKD/FSGS)与肝细胞损伤分数 HDS(MASLD/NASH);在小鼠与人的 scRNA、snRNA、空间转录组、蛋白组、组织学与临床数据中都能检出疾病相关损伤,能"对齐"不同疾病模型,并在未扰动的对照细胞中也分辨出损伤程度差异。

nodes.label: Kidney multiome (mBDRC)
nodes.title: Systematic evaluation of single-cell multimodal data integration enhances cell type resolution and discovery of clinically relevant states in complex tissues

oneliner.en: On renal cortex from 19 healthy donors the authors run 3' scRNA-seq, 5' scRNA-seq and 10x multiome (snRNA + snATAC) side by side, yielding the 119,744-cell/nucleus benchmark mBDRC, and build scOMM, an interpretable supervised classifier, to systematically compare "horizontal" (sc↔sn RNA), "vertical" (RNA↔ATAC in the same nuclei) and "global" (mosaic/diagonal) integration for resolving kidney cell types and states. Global integration recovers a WFDC2⁺ adaptive-TAL subpopulation and EPO-producing Norn cells that single modalities miss.
oneliner.zh: 作者在 19 位健康供体的肾皮质上同时做 3' scRNA-seq、5' scRNA-seq 与 10x multiome(snRNA + snATAC),得到 119,744 个细胞/核的基准数据集 mBDRC,并开发可解释的监督式分类器 scOMM,系统比较「水平(sc↔sn RNA)」「垂直(RNA↔ATAC 同一细胞)」「全局(mosaic/diagonal)」三类整合策略对肾细胞类型/状态分辨率的贡献;全局整合找回了单一模态里看不到的 WFDC2⁺ aTAL 亚群与产 EPO 的 Norn 细胞。

nodes.label: CellSpectra
nodes.title: Analysis of individual patient pathway coordination in a cross-species single-cell kidney atlas

oneliner.en: Two things: (1) SISKA 1.0 — a cross-species single-nucleus kidney atlas (human, mouse, rat; >1M cells, >140 samples) with 21 main cell types and ~80 cross-species-conserved cell states; (2) CellSpectra — a single-sample statistic: for each cell type × pathway, the first SVD axis of the reference samples' pseudobulk matrix defines the "coordination pattern"; a query sample is regressed onto it, and lowered R² plus a χ² test flags loss of coordination in that sample. This powers a patient-level single-cell functional profiling report, rodent-model selection for a patient, and — in a folic-acid kidney-injury model — the CellSpectra-nominated TNF pathway was targeted with etanercept, improving kidney function.
oneliner.zh: 两件事:(1) SISKA 1.0 —— 人、小鼠、大鼠 > 100 万细胞、> 140 个样本的跨物种单细胞(snRNA)肾脏图谱,21 个主要细胞类型、近 80 个跨物种保守的细胞状态;(2) CellSpectra —— 一个单样本统计工具:对每个细胞类型 × 通路,用参照样本伪 bulk 矩阵的 SVD 第一主轴作为"协调模式",把待测样本回归上去,R² 降低 + χ² 检验即判为该样本该通路"协调性丢失";据此生成患者级单细胞功能画像报告、为患者选择最匹配的啮齿类模型,并在叶酸肾损伤模型中由 CellSpectra 提名的 TNF 通路用 etanercept 干预改善了肾功能。

nodes.label: Reference-mapping QC
nodes.title: Automated evaluation of single-cell reference atlas mappings enables the identification of disease-associated cell states

oneliner.en: MapQC (Theis lab) uses the healthy reference atlas's own inter-sample variation as a null distribution to judge whether a query→reference mapping succeeded: query control samples should sit at a "normal" distance from the reference (mapQC score < 2), and case samples should be "abnormally" distant in some cells (> 2). It catches residual batch effects invisible in UMAPs, prevents artifacts from being reported as disease states, and is more interpretable than repurposed integration metrics (LISI, kBET, etc.).
oneliner.zh: MapQC(Theis 组)用健康参照 atlas 自身的样本间差异作为零分布,来判断一次 query→reference 映射是否成功:query 的 control 样本应与参照「正常地远」(mapQC 分数 < 2),case 样本应在部分细胞中「异常地远」(> 2)。它能检出 UMAP 看不出来的残留 batch effect,防止把 artifact 报告成疾病状态,而且比重新拿来用的整合指标(LISI、kBET 等)更可解释。

nodes.label: Kidney atlas (Abedini 2024)
nodes.title: Single-cell multi-omic and spatial profiling of human kidneys implicates the fibrotic microenvironment in kidney disease progression

oneliner.en: A UPenn (Susztak lab) multi-omic and spatial atlas of the human kidney: 81 samples from 58 participants (Supplementary Table 1 actually lists 57 IDs) profiled by scRNA-seq, snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq (three separate libraries, not multiome), Visium FFPE and CosMx. The integrated SCVI atlas holds 338,565 cells/nuclei in 44 main types and 114 subtypes/states. NMF on Visium finds four microenvironments (glomerular, tubule, fibrotic, immune). A fibrotic-microenvironment gene signature (FME-GS) predicts kidney-function decline in 245 bulk tubule samples with fibrosis < 10% (HR = 3.95), where the pathologist's fibrosis score does not (HR = 1.17).
oneliner.zh: Susztak 实验室(UPenn)的人肾多组学 + 空间图谱:来自 58 名参与者(补充表 1 实际列出 57 个 ID)的 81 份样本,做了 scRNA-seq、snRNA-seq、snATAC-seq(三者独立建库,不是 multiome)、Visium FFPE 和 CosMx。整合后的 SCVI 图谱有 338,565 个细胞/细胞核、44 种主要细胞类型和 114 种亚型/状态。Visium 经 NMF 分出四种微环境(肾小球 / 小管 / 纤维化 / 免疫)。由纤维化微环境得到的 FME 基因签名(FME-GS),在 fibrosis < 10% 的 245 例 bulk 小管样本中仍能预测肾功能下降(HR = 3.95),而病理纤维化评分做不到(HR = 1.17)。

nodes.label: SNP multiplexing (Hoeft)
nodes.title: Label-free single-cell RNA multiplexing leveraging genetic variability

oneliner.en: Hayat/Kramann lab present SoupLadle: reference-free SNP deconvolution of pooled sc/snRNA-seq with Souporcell, then re-assignment of each genotype cluster to a patient by Hamming distance + Kuhn-Munkres matching against per-patient bulkRNA-seq SNPs; it gives the highest recall and least cell-type bias on PBMC, two heart snRNA cohorts and 4 frozen human kidney biopsies (snRNA, 11,490 nuclei).
oneliner.zh: Hayat/Kramann 组提出 SoupLadle:先用 Souporcell 按 SNP 对 pooled sc/snRNA-seq 做无参考 deconvolution,再用每位患者的 bulkRNA-seq SNP 通过 Hamming 距离 + Kuhn-Munkres 匹配把 genotype cluster 还原到患者;在 PBMC、两个心脏 snRNA 队列和 4 例冷冻人肾活检 snRNA(11,490 nuclei)上召回率最高、cell-type bias 最小。

nodes.label: Ambient truth, mouse kidney (Janssen)
nodes.title: The effect of background noise and its removal on the analysis of single-cell expression data

oneliner.en: Kidney cells from two mouse subspecies (*M. m. castaneus* CAST/EiJ and *M. m. domesticus* C57BL/6J and 129S1/SvImJ) are pooled in one 10x channel so that subspecies-diagnostic homozygous SNPs separate endogenous from foreign molecules, giving a genotype-based ground truth for the per-cell background-noise fraction ρ_cell. Background noise varies widely between replicates and cells (3–35% of UMIs on average), comes mostly from ambient RNA rather than barcode swapping, and — used as ground truth to benchmark CellBender / DecontX / SoupX — CellBender gives the most precise estimates and the biggest gain for marker genes, while clustering and classification are fairly robust to background noise.
oneliner.zh: 把来自两个小鼠亚种(*M. m. castaneus* CAST/EiJ 与 *M. m. domesticus* C57BL/6J、129S1/SvImJ)的肾脏细胞混在同一个 10x 通道里,用亚种间纯合 SNP 区分「本细胞的分子」和「外来分子」,从而得到每个细胞背景噪声比例 ρ_cell 的基因型真值;发现背景噪声在重复间、细胞间差异很大(平均 3–35% 的 UMI),主要来自 ambient RNA 而非 barcode swapping,并以此真值评测 CellBender / DecontX / SoupX —— CellBender 估计最准、对 marker 基因改善最大,而聚类与分类对背景噪声相当稳健。

nodes.label: Healthy-reference design
nodes.title: Precise identification of cell states altered in disease using healthy single-cell references

oneliner.en: When using a "healthy reference" to find disease-altered cell states, which reference should you use? The authors give a systematic answer: learn the latent space on a large healthy atlas (scVI + scArches mapping), then run differential-abundance testing (Milo) against matched controls only — the ACR (atlas-to-control reference) design. It beats atlas-only (false positives explode) and control-only (misses multiple altered states), and with an atlas available, the number of controls can be cut without inflating FDR.
oneliner.zh: 用「健康参照」找疾病改变的细胞状态时,参照该怎么选?作者给出系统答案:用大规模健康 atlas 学 latent space(scVI + scArches 映射),再只拿匹配的 control 样本做差异丰度检验(Milo)——即 ACR(atlas-to-control reference)设计;它比只用 atlas(假阳性暴涨)或只用 control(漏掉多种异常状态)都更准,且有 atlas 时可以少采 control 而不增加 FDR。

nodes.label: Dissociation bias, mouse kidney
nodes.title: Systematic assessment of tissue dissociation and storage biases in single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq workflows

oneliner.en: A single-system (healthy adult mouse kidney, 10x Chromium), triplicate comparison of 37 °C vs on-ice cold-protease dissociation, fresh vs cryopreserved vs methanol-fixed cells, and scRNA-seq vs three snRNA-seq nuclei workflows (with bulk RNA-seq controls), quantifying protocol-induced expression artifacts (stress genes) and cell-composition biases; all data public as GSE141115.
oneliner.zh: 在同一系统(健康成年小鼠肾,10x Chromium)里、三生物学重复地系统比较 37 °C vs 冰上冷蛋白酶解离、新鲜 vs 冻存 vs 甲醇固定、scRNA-seq vs 三种 snRNA-seq 核提取流程(加 bulk RNA-seq 对照),量化每种流程带来的表达伪影(应激基因)和细胞组成偏差;全部数据公开于 GSE141115。

nodes.label: Transplant chimerism (Malone)
nodes.title: Harnessing Expressed Single Nucleotide Variation and Single Cell RNA Sequencing To Define Immune Cell Chimerism in the Rejecting Kidney Transplant
nodes.venue: Journal of the American Society of Nephrology

oneliner.en: Donor/recipient paired whole-exome sequencing provides an SNV reference (.vcf); Demuxlet on 10x 5′ scRNA-seq of five kidney-transplant biopsies (81,139 cells) assigns each cell to donor or recipient, showing donor macrophages persist in non-rejecting grafts with transcriptional programs distinct from recipient macrophages.
oneliner.zh: 用 donor/recipient 配对 WES 生成 SNV 参考(.vcf),对 5 个肾移植活检的 10x 5′ scRNA-seq(81,139 个细胞)跑 Demuxlet,逐细胞判定供体/受体来源,发现供体巨噬细胞在非排斥移植肾中可持续存在、且与受体巨噬细胞转录程序不同。

nodes.label: Kidney snRNA processing (Lake 2019)
nodes.title: A single-nucleus RNA-sequencing pipeline to decipher the molecular anatomy and pathophysiology of human kidneys

oneliner.en: An early KPMP methods paper: after comparing 7 kidney tissue preservation/processing methods, it profiles adult human kidney with snDrop-seq (15 individuals, 27 experiments, 47 libraries), yielding 17,659 post-QC nuclei in 30 clusters; it concludes that O.C.T. cryosections preserved in RNAlater (cryoR) give the fewest MT transcripts and stress artifacts with >90% success, whereas enzymatic dissociation (dissocPC/TC) induces a FOS/FOSB/DNAJB1 stress signature and an artifact cluster (PC-2).
oneliner.zh: KPMP 早期的方法学论文:比较 7 种肾组织保存/处理方式后,用 snDrop-seq 对 15 人、27 次实验、47 个文库的成人肾做单核转录组,QC 后 17,659 个细胞核聚成 30 个群;结论是 O.C.T. 冷冻切片 + RNAlater 保存(cryoR) 的 MT 转录本与应激伪影最少、成功率 >90%,而酶解离(dissocPC/TC)诱导 FOS/FOSB/DNAJB1 应激签名并产生一个伪影簇(PC-2)。

nodes.label: Ambient-RNA benchmark
nodes.title: Benchmarking computational decontamination of ambient RNA

oneliner.en: An independent benchmark using simulations, species-mixing experiments of three complexities, a mouse-kidney strain (genotype) mixing experiment and contamination-free negative controls to evaluate 7 ambient-RNA decontamination methods (CellBender, DecontX, FastCAR, scAR, scCDC, SoupX, CellClear) on how much ambient RNA they remove, how much endogenous RNA they keep, and how they change downstream interpretation; no method wins everywhere — CellBender, DecontX (full mode) or SoupX (reduced mode) are recommended — and default decontamination of clean data risks over-correction.
oneliner.zh: 一个独立基准,用模拟数据、三种复杂度的物种混合实验、小鼠肾脏品系(基因型)混合实验和无污染负对照,评测 7 种 ambient RNA 去污染方法(CellBender、DecontX、FastCAR、scAR、scCDC、SoupX、CellClear)「去掉多少外源 RNA、保留多少内源 RNA、对下游解读有何影响」;结论是没有通吃的方法,推荐 CellBender、DecontX(full 模式)或 SoupX(reduced 模式),并警告在无污染数据上默认去污染会过度校正。

nodes.label: Conditional Monge Gap
nodes.title: Conditional Monge Gap enables generalizable single-cell perturbation modelling

oneliner.en: CMonge (Conditional Monge Gap) uses one neural optimal-transport (OT) model, conditioned on drug, dose or drug combination, to map the distribution of untreated cells onto the distribution of treated cells; it can predict single-cell responses to unseen drugs from their molecular structure alone.
oneliner.zh: CMonge(Conditional Monge Gap)用一个神经最优传输(OT)模型,在药物、剂量或药物组合等条件下,把"未处理细胞的分布"搬运成"处理后细胞的分布";它可以只凭药物分子结构去预测没见过的药物的单细胞响应。

nodes.label: Kidney epigenome atlas
nodes.title: A cross-species single-cell kidney epigenome atlas reveals epithelial-dominant aging-like states in disease

oneliner.en: The authors build a cross-species (human + mouse) single-cell kidney epigenome atlas — single-cell DNA methylation (sciMET) + matched 10x Multiome (RNA+ATAC) + Xenium 5K spatial transcriptomics + scMethyl-Hi-C — and find that disease-associated epigenetic age acceleration is concentrated in tubular epithelial cells (on average 4.8 years), that altered PT cells' methylation and expression changes overlap normal-aging transcriptional trajectories, preferentially hit CpG-island-less lineage genes, and map to spatial niches of unresolved repair.
oneliner.zh: 作者构建了一个跨物种(人 + 小鼠)的单细胞肾脏表观基因组图谱 —— 单细胞 DNA 甲基化(sciMET)+ 匹配的 10x Multiome(RNA+ATAC)+ Xenium 5K 空间转录组 + scMethyl-Hi-C —— 发现肾病中的表观遗传年龄加速主要发生在小管上皮细胞(平均快 4.8 年),病变 PT 细胞的甲基化与表达改变和正常衰老的转录轨迹重叠,集中于缺少 CpG 岛的谱系基因,并定位到未完成修复的空间 niche。

nodes.label: Novel types in scATAC
nodes.title: Robust annotation and discovery of novel cell types in single-cell ATAC-seq data through cross-modal reference alignment

oneliner.en: CARA is a cross-modal Bayesian framework that transfers cell-type knowledge from an scRNA-seq reference to scATAC-seq: pretraining on scRNA, semi-supervised learning on the target scATAC, plus distribution alignment, dynamic class weighting and novel-type detection — jointly annotating, batch-correcting and flagging populations absent from the reference (novel, rare or aberrant).
oneliner.zh: CARA 是一个跨模态贝叶斯框架,把 scRNA-seq 参照中的细胞类型知识迁移到 scATAC-seq:在 scRNA 上预训练,在目标 scATAC 上做半监督学习,配合分布对齐、动态类别加权和新细胞类型检测,同时完成注释、批次校正和识别参照中不存在的(新的、稀有的或异常的)细胞群。

nodes.label: Conformal annotation
nodes.title: Conformal inference for reliable single cell RNA-seq annotation

oneliner.en: Adds distribution-free statistical guarantees to automatic scRNA-seq annotation with conformal prediction: an autoencoder + conformal p-values first detects cell types absent from the reference (OOD) with false-positive rate ≤ α₀; the remaining cells get prediction sets with coverage guarantees (standard / classwise / cluster Mondrian taxonomies; APS / RAPS / THR non-conformity scores), where set size is the uncertainty. Departures of the conformal p-values from uniformity also diagnose broken reference–query exchangeability.
oneliner.zh: 用 conformal prediction 给 scRNA-seq 自动注释加上分布无关的统计保证:先用自编码器 + conformal p 值检测参照中不存在的细胞类型(OOD),控制假阳性率 ≤ α₀;再对剩下的细胞输出带覆盖保证的预测集合(标准 / classwise / cluster 三种 Mondrian 分类方式,APS / RAPS / THR 三种非一致性分数),集合大小即不确定性;conformal p 值分布偏离均匀还可以用来诊断参照与 query 之间的可交换性是否被破坏。

nodes.label: Inflammatory PT cells
nodes.title: Multiomic analysis of human kidney disease identifies a tractable inflammatory and pro-fibrotic tubular cell phenotype

oneliner.en: Combining snRNA+snATAC multiome with CosMx high-plex single-cell spatial imaging (6,000- and 1,000-plex), the authors identify a VCAM1+ICAM1+ inflammatory proximal-tubule (PT) cell in human kidney disease: a subset of KPMP "adaptive PT" cells that expresses chemokines, pro-fibrotic and senescence-associated genes and localizes specifically to the fibrotic niche; it is epigenetically imprinted by HNF4α-network collapse plus AP-1/NF-κB activation; in mice the AP-1 inhibitor T5224 or the senolytic ABT-263 depletes these cells and reduces inflammation and fibrosis.
oneliner.zh: 作者把 snRNA+snATAC 多组学与 CosMx 高通量单细胞空间成像(6,000 与 1,000 探针)结合,在人类肾病中找到一类 VCAM1+ICAM1+ 炎症性近端小管(PT)细胞:它们是 KPMP「adaptive PT」的一个亚群,表达趋化因子、促纤维化与衰老相关基因,特异地定位在纤维化 niche;表观上由 HNF4α 网络崩溃 + AP-1/NF-κB 激活锁定;在小鼠中用 AP-1 抑制剂 T5224 或衰老清除剂 ABT-263 能减少这类细胞并减轻炎症和纤维化。

nodes.label: Integration benchmark
nodes.title: Benchmarking single-cell multi-modal data integrations

oneliner.en: SCMMIB: a Registered Report benchmarking 40 single-cell multimodal integration algorithms (65 method×task combinations) on six tasks — paired RNA+ATAC, paired RNA+ADT, spatial multi-omics, unpaired RNA+ATAC diagonal, RNA+ATAC mosaic and RNA+ADT mosaic — over 101 benchmark datasets derived from 14 public datasets, scoring usability, accuracy and robustness. Seurat v4 WNN (paired RNA+ATAC) and GLUE (unpaired diagonal) are SOTA for their tasks; MIDAS is SOTA for mosaic cross-modality imputation.
oneliner.zh: SCMMIB:以 Registered Report 形式,对 40 个单细胞多模态整合算法(拆成 65 个「方法×任务」)在 6 类任务上 —— 配对 RNA+ATAC、配对 RNA+ADT、空间多组学、非配对 RNA+ATAC 对角整合、RNA+ATAC mosaic、RNA+ADT mosaic —— 用 14 个公开数据集派生的 101 个基准数据集评估可用性、准确性与鲁棒性;Seurat v4 WNN(配对 RNA+ATAC)与 GLUE(非配对对角)是各自任务的 SOTA,MIDAS 是 mosaic 跨模态插补的 SOTA。

nodes.label: MrVI
nodes.title: Deep generative modeling of sample-level heterogeneity in single-cell genomics

oneliner.en: MrVI (multi-resolution variational inference, Yosef lab, built into scvi-tools) is a hierarchical deep generative model with two latent variables: u encodes cell state only (sample-agnostic), z adds sample effects on top of u (free of nuisance factors such as batch). Using counterfactuals — "what would this cell look like had it come from another sample?" — it stratifies samples at single-cell resolution (exploratory) and runs cluster-free DE and DA (comparative), finding sample-level differences that show up only in particular cell subsets in COVID-19, sci-Plex drug-screen and Crohn's disease cohorts.
oneliner.zh: MrVI(multi-resolution variational inference,Yosef 组,scvi-tools 内置)是一个两层隐变量的层级深度生成模型:u 只编码细胞状态(与样本无关),z 在 u 基础上加入样本效应(与 batch 等 nuisance 无关);通过反事实——「这个细胞如果来自另一个样本会怎样」——在单细胞分辨率上做样本分层(exploratory)以及不依赖聚类的 DE 与 DA(comparative),在 COVID-19、sci-Plex 药物筛选和克罗恩病队列上发现了只在部分细胞亚群中体现的样本差异。

nodes.label: DKD spatial atlas
nodes.title: Spatial atlas of diabetic kidney disease reveals a B cell-rich subgroup

oneliner.en: CosMx (1k genes) and Xenium (5k genes) single-cell spatial transcriptomics on 64 FFPE kidney samples from 58 patients, integrated with a 150-patient snRNA-seq reference via scVI/scANVI into a >5-million-cell cross-platform DKD spatial atlas; it defines 11 reproducible tissue niches and cell-centred "microenvironments", finds a profibrotic injured-tubule microenvironment that expands with disease and tracks lower eGFR, and within it a B cell-predominant, TLS-like immune microenvironment marking a faster-progressing DKD subset (B+ DKD, ~8.4%) — yielding a tissue gene signature and a 14-protein plasma panel (UK Biobank external AUC 0.70 vs KFRE 0.63).
oneliner.zh: 用 CosMx(1k 基因)与 Xenium(5k 基因) 单细胞空间转录组对 58 名患者的 64 个 FFPE 肾样本建图,并与 150 例 snRNA-seq 参照用 scVI/scANVI 整合成 > 500 万细胞的跨平台 DKD 空间图谱;定义 11 个可复现的组织 niche 与以细胞为中心的"microenvironment",发现随病情扩张、与 eGFR 负相关的促纤维化损伤小管微环境,以及其中嵌入的、B 细胞为主的 TLS 样免疫微环境——它标志一个进展更快的 DKD 亚群(B+ DKD,约 8.4%),并据此得到组织基因签名与 14 蛋白血浆 panel(UK Biobank 外部验证 AUC 0.70 vs KFRE 0.63)。

nodes.label: ovrlpy
nodes.title: Identifying 3D signal overlaps in spatial transcriptomics data with ovrlpy

oneliner.en: ovrlpy computationally "splits" a 5–15-µm imaging-based spatial-transcriptomics section into virtual top and bottom sub-slices and compares their local expression similarity, producing an unsupervised, segmentation-free vertical signal integrity (VSI) map that localizes vertically overlapping cells (z-axis doublets), tissue folds and inaccurate segmentation.
oneliner.zh: ovrlpy 把成像型空间转录组的 5–15 µm 厚切片在计算上「虚拟切成上下两层」,比较上下层的局部表达相似度,得到一张无监督、无需分割的垂直信号完整性(VSI)图,用来定位垂直重叠细胞(z 轴双细胞)、组织褶皱和不准确的细胞分割。

nodes.label: ResolVI
nodes.title: ResolVI: addressing noise and bias in spatial transcriptomics

oneliner.en: resolVI is a VAE-based generative model in scvi-tools that sits downstream of any segmentation algorithm and decomposes each cell's observed counts into three parts — the cell's true expression, expression "diffused" in from neighbouring cells, and a per-slice constant non-specific background — removing spurious co-expression caused by molecule misassignment while producing a batch-corrected probabilistic latent representation that supports differential expression and differential niche-abundance testing.
oneliner.zh: resolVI 是 scvi-tools 里的一个 VAE 生成模型,接在任意分割算法之后,把每个细胞的观测计数拆成三部分 —— 细胞自身的真实表达、从邻近细胞「扩散」进来的表达、以及每张切片恒定的非特异背景 —— 从而去除分子错配导致的虚假共表达,同时给出批次校正后的概率潜在表示,支持差异表达和空间邻域丰度检验。

nodes.label: Xenium contamination (SPLIT)
nodes.title: Resolving sensitivity, specificity and signal contamination in Xenium spatial transcriptomics

oneliner.en: Using 41 breast-cancer and NSCLC sections from 27 donors (targeted Breast/Lung/Custom IO panels plus the 5K PRIME panel, with matched snRNA-seq and IHC), the authors systematically characterize Xenium sensitivity, specificity and transcript-spillover contamination, and propose SPLIT: take RCTD doublet-mode cell-type weights and split each contaminated cell's counts into "primary" and "secondary" parts according to reference profiles, keeping the purified primary profile.
oneliner.zh: 作者用 27 位供者、41 张乳腺癌与非小细胞肺癌切片(靶向 Breast/Lung/Custom IO 面板 + 5K PRIME 面板,配匹配 snRNA-seq 与 IHC)系统刻画 Xenium 的灵敏度、特异性和转录本溢出(spillover)污染,并提出 SPLIT:用 RCTD doublet 模式的细胞类型权重,把每个被污染细胞的计数按参照谱拆成「主」「次」两部分,只保留主细胞类型的纯化表达。

nodes.label: Loki / OmiCLIP
nodes.title: A visual–omics foundation model to bridge histopathology with spatial transcriptomics

oneliner.en: OmiCLIP writes each Visium spot's transcriptome as a "sentence" of gene symbols ranked by expression and contrastively aligns it with the matching H&E patch in a CLIP/CoCa setup (ST-bank: 2.2M pairs, 1,007 samples, 32 organs); the Loki platform built on top offers five modules — tissue alignment, tissue annotation, cell-type decomposition, image↔transcriptome retrieval and ST expression prediction from H&E.
oneliner.zh: OmiCLIP 把每个 Visium spot 的转录组写成「按表达量排序的基因符号句子」,与对应 H&E patch 做 CLIP/CoCa 式对比学习(ST-bank:2.2M 对、1,007 个样本、32 个器官);在此之上的 Loki 平台提供五个模块 —— 组织对齐、组织注释、细胞类型分解、图像↔转录组检索、从 H&E 预测 ST 表达。

nodes.label: MEATRD
nodes.title: MEATRD: Multimodal Anomalous Tissue Region Detection Enhanced with Spatial Transcriptomics
nodes.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

oneliner.en: MEATRD is a follow-up from the STANDS group (Xu, Sun et al.): trained only on normal tissue, it treats each Visium spot as a graph node, reconstructs both its H&E patch and its gene expression (core: a masked graph dual-attention transformer, MGDAT, with target-node masking), then trains a Deep-SVDD-style one-class classifier on latent multimodal reconstruction errors for anomaly scoring. On 8 human breast-cancer ST datasets it reaches mean AUC 0.723 / F1 0.741, beating 9 image, ST and multimodal baselines, and catches visually subtle tumour edges.
oneliner.zh: MEATRD 是 STANDS 同组(Xu、Sun 等)的后续工作:只用正常组织训练,把每个 Visium spot 作为图节点,同时重建其 H&E 图块与基因表达(核心是带目标节点 masking 的图双注意力 Transformer,MGDAT),再在潜在多模态重建误差上训练 Deep-SVDD 式的单类分类器做异常打分;在 8 个人乳腺癌 ST 数据上平均 AUC 0.723 / F1 0.741,超过 9 个图像、ST 与多模态基线,并能抓住肉眼难辨的肿瘤边缘。

nodes.label: MintFlow
nodes.title: Mapping and reprogramming human tissue microenvironments with MintFlow

oneliner.en: MintFlow is a flow-matching generative model for single-cell-resolution spatial transcriptomics (Xenium): it splits each cell's expression into an intrinsic part and a microenvironment-induced part, and can delete or replace a cell type in silico to predict how neighbouring cells' expression would change.
oneliner.zh: MintFlow 是一个基于 flow matching 的生成模型:在单细胞分辨率空间转录组(Xenium)上,把每个细胞的表达拆成"细胞本身(intrinsic)"和"由周围微环境诱导(microenvironment-induced)"两部分,并能在电脑里删除或替换某类细胞,预测邻近细胞表达如何变化。

nodes.label: Sardine
nodes.title: Anomaly detection in spatial transcriptomics via spatially localized density comparison

oneliner.en: Sardine formalizes "anomalous-region detection across conditions" in spatial transcriptomics as the spatially localized differential abundance region problem (SDARP): on multi-condition slices aligned to a common coordinate system, it takes a spatial neighbourhood around every spot, estimates densities on the expression-manifold kNN graph with MELD-style graph smoothing, and compares local densities between conditions — producing an interpretable anomaly score where 0.5 = no change and →1 = anomalous. It is more accurate and more spatially coherent than MELD, Vespucci and STANDS on simulations and two mouse Visium datasets.
oneliner.zh: Sardine 把空间转录组的「条件间异常区域检测」形式化为空间局部化差异丰度问题(SDARP):在对齐到同一坐标系的多条件切片上,对每个 spot 取空间邻域、在表达流形 kNN 图上用 MELD 式图平滑做密度估计,比较两条件的局部密度,得到 0.5 = 无变化、→1 = 异常的可解释 anomaly score;在模拟和两个小鼠 Visium 数据上比 MELD、Vespucci、STANDS 更准、更空间连贯。

nodes.label: Kidney atlas (Lake 2023)
nodes.title: An atlas of healthy and injured cell states and niches in the human kidney

oneliner.en: A KPMP / HuBMAP / HCA multimodal single-cell + spatial atlas of the human kidney: >400,000 cells/nuclei (snRNA, scRNA, SNARE-seq2 dual-omics) plus Slide-seq2, Visium and large-scale 3D imaging, spanning 45 healthy reference donors and 48 AKI/CKD patients; it defines 51 main cell types and 28 injury-associated "altered states" (cycling, adaptive/maladaptive repair, transitioning, degenerative), localizes them to injury niches, and shows that TAL/PT adaptive-repair signatures predict decline of kidney function.
oneliner.zh: KPMP / HuBMAP / HCA 联合构建的人肾多模态单细胞 + 空间图谱:> 40 万个细胞/细胞核(snRNA、scRNA、SNARE-seq2 双组学),配合 Slide-seq2、Visium 与大规模 3D 成像,覆盖 45 名健康参照供体与 48 名 AKI/CKD 患者,定义 51 种主要细胞类型和 28 种损伤相关的"altered states"(cycling、adaptive/maladaptive repair、transitioning、degenerative),把它们定位到损伤 niche,并发现 TAL/PT 的 adaptive 修复签名可预测肾功能下降。

nodes.label: STANDS
nodes.title: Detecting anomalous anatomic regions in spatial transcriptomics with STANDS

oneliner.en: STANDS is a GAN-based multi-sample spatial-transcriptomics (ST) framework: it learns to reconstruct normal spots from a "normal" reference section, flags poorly reconstructed spots in target sections as anomalous tissue domains (ATDs), aligns several samples into the reference space, and clusters the anomalies into subtypes that are shared across samples or sample-specific — without any predefined anomaly marker genes.
oneliner.zh: STANDS 是一套基于 GAN 的多样本空间转录组(ST)框架:先在"正常"参考切片上学会重建正常 spot,把重建得差的 spot 标为异常组织域(ATD);再把多个样本对齐到参考空间;最后把异常聚成"跨样本共享 / 样本特有"的亚型——全程不需要预先给出异常 marker 基因。

nodes.label: Virtual tissues (spatial proteomics)
nodes.title: AI-powered virtual tissues from spatial proteomics for clinical diagnostics and biomedical discovery

oneliner.en: VirTues (Virtual Tissues) is a foundation model for spatial proteomics: each marker channel of a multiplexed image is tokenised and tagged with a protein-language-model (ESM-2) embedding of that protein, and a ViT with factorised spatial / marker attention is pretrained as a masked autoencoder; one backbone then supports marker reconstruction, cell typing, tissue-level clinical prediction, case retrieval and cross-cohort biomarker discovery.
oneliner.zh: VirTues(Virtual Tissues)是空间蛋白质组学的基础模型:把多重成像的每个 marker 通道切成 token,并用蛋白质语言模型(ESM-2)的嵌入告诉模型"这是哪个蛋白",用"空间注意力 / marker 注意力"分解的 ViT 做掩码自编码预训练;一个预训练骨干即可做 marker 重建、细胞分型、组织级临床预测、病例检索和跨队列生物标志物发现。

nodes.label: Spatial biomarker discovery
nodes.title: Spatial biomarker discovery via interpretable semantic learning in histopathology

oneliner.en: PathPrism segments colorectal-cancer H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) into 8-class tissue maps, turns each map into 628 mathematically defined spatial features (tissue fractions, spatial entropy, tissue-graph features), and fits linear models for prognosis, mutations and chemotherapy benefit; VirtualWSI then perturbs the tissue map ("grow / shrink one tissue class") and tracks how risk and features move.
oneliner.zh: PathPrism 先把结直肠癌 H&E 全切片(WSI)分割成 8 类组织的语义图,再把语义图拆成 628 个有数学定义的空间特征(组织占比、空间熵、组织图特征),用线性模型预测预后、突变和化疗获益;VirtualWSI 在这张语义图上做"放大/缩小某类组织"的虚拟扰动,观察风险分和特征如何变化。

nodes.label: Pathology AD benchmark
nodes.title: Quantitative benchmarking of anomaly detection methods in digital pathology images

oneliner.en: Yuankai Huo's group (HRLB, Vanderbilt) benchmarks 23 generic anomaly-detection methods (reconstruction, feature-distribution, distillation, normalizing-flow and synthetic-anomaly families) under one protocol on real pathology (Camelyon16, Crohn's colon, mouse glomeruli), controlled synthetic pathology and MVTec industrial data, and systematically studies three under-examined factors — image scale, "reversed" anomaly patterns, and how to pick a training epoch when no anomalies are available. No method wins everywhere; feature-distribution methods are best overall; and real pathology is far harder than industrial data (mean ROC-AUC ≈ 0.645 vs 0.888).
oneliner.zh: Vanderbilt 的 Huo 组(HRLB)把 23 种通用 anomaly detection 方法(重建、特征分布、蒸馏、normalizing flow、合成异常五大类)放到真实病理(Camelyon16、Crohn 结肠、小鼠肾小球)+ 受控合成病理 + MVTec 工业数据上统一评测,系统考察图像尺度、异常模式「反转」、以及没有异常样本时如何选 epoch 三个常被忽略的因素;结论是没有通吃的方法,特征分布类整体最好,而真实病理比工业数据难得多(平均 ROC-AUC 约 0.645 对 0.888)。

nodes.label: Clinical-grade histo AD
nodes.title: AI-Based Anomaly Detection for Clinical-Grade Histopathological Diagnostics

oneliner.en: A deep anomaly-detection model trained only on "frequent findings" (normal tissue plus common diseases) of stomach and colon biopsies — best variant: Outlier Exposure — detects the long tail of 56 rarer entities it never saw, with slide-AUROC 95.0% (stomach) and 91.0% (colon), and transfers to a second hospital and scanner without retraining.
oneliner.zh: 只用"常见诊断"(正常组织 + 常见病)的胃、结肠活检切片训练深度异常检测模型(最佳为 Outlier Exposure),不需要见过任何罕见病,就能检出长尾中的 56 种少见病变:slide-AUROC 胃 95.0%、结肠 91.0%,并可泛化到另一家医院和另一种扫描仪。

nodes.label: Counterfactual diffusion
nodes.title: Counterfactual Diffusion Models Provide Interpretable Explanations of Artificial Intelligence Models in Pathology

oneliner.en: MoPaDi (Morphing histoPathology Diffusion) couples a diffusion autoencoder with tile-level logistic-regression or slide-level MIL classifiers: it pushes a tile's latent feature vector along the classifier's decision direction and decodes it with the conditional diffusion model into a counterfactual H&E image ("what would this tile look like if it were class X?"), so pathologists can see the morphologic cues a model relies on. Validated on colorectal (tissue type, MSI), hepatobiliary, lung and breast tasks, with a Shapley-style decomposition showing MSI predictions are driven mostly by morphology rather than stain.
oneliner.zh: MoPaDi(Morphing histoPathology Diffusion)把 diffusion autoencoder 与 tile 级 logistic regression / slide 级 MIL 分类器接起来:沿分类器在潜空间里的决策方向推动 tile 的特征向量,再用条件扩散解码器生成"如果它是另一类会长什么样"的 counterfactual H&E 图像,让病理医生直接看到模型依赖的形态学线索;在结直肠(组织类型、MSI)、肝胆、肺、乳腺癌任务上验证,并用 Shapley 式分解说明 MSI 预测主要由形态而非染色驱动。

nodes.label: H&E→expression benchmark
nodes.title: Benchmarking the translational potential of spatial gene expression prediction from histology

oneliner.en: An independent reproduction and evaluation of 11 methods that predict spatial gene expression (SGE) from H&E: 5 SRT datasets plus TCGA-BRCA external validation, 28 metrics spanning accuracy, generalisability, clinical translation (survival), usability and compute. No method wins everywhere; all-gene mean correlation is typically < 0.25, more complex architectures are not better, and survival stratification is mostly non-significant under cross-validation.
oneliner.zh: 对 11 个「从 H&E 预测空间基因表达(SGE)」的方法做独立复现与评测:5 个 SRT 数据集 + TCGA-BRCA 外部验证,28 个指标覆盖预测精度、泛化、临床转化(生存)、可用性与计算效率;结论是没有一个方法全面最优,全基因平均相关性普遍 < 0.25,复杂架构并不更好,且在交叉验证下生存分层基本不显著。

nodes.label: Kidney histology SSL
nodes.title: Unbiased self supervised learning of kidney histology reveals phenotypic and prognostic insights

oneliner.en: NYU (Tsirigos lab) with JHU/UPenn applies Histomorphological Phenotype Learning (HPL), a self-supervised framework first built for lung-cancer H&E, to 1,421 PAS-stained kidney WSIs: with no pathologist labels, tile embeddings are clustered into histomorphological phenotype clusters (HPCs) and each slide becomes a vector of HPC area fractions. The clusters are visually consistent across five internal/external sets, track pathologist quantifications such as interstitial fibrosis (MIL AUC 0.83), and predict kidney-function decline in the TRIDENT diabetic-nephropathy cohort.
oneliner.zh: NYU(Tsirigos 组)与 JHU/UPenn 把原本为肺癌 H&E 开发的自监督框架 Histomorphological Phenotype Learning(HPL)用到 1,421 张 PAS 染色肾脏 WSI 上:不用任何病理标注,把 tile 嵌入聚成「组织形态表型簇」(HPC),每张切片表示为各 HPC 的面积占比向量;这些簇跨 5 个内外部队列视觉一致、与间质纤维化等病理定量相关(MIL 预测纤维化 AUC 0.83),并能预测 TRIDENT 糖尿病肾病队列的肾功能下降。

nodes.label: Latent-diffusion AD
nodes.title: Pathology-Informed Latent Diffusion Model for Anomaly Detection in Lymph Node Metastasis

oneliner.en: AnoPILaD fine-tunes a text-conditioned latent diffusion model (Stable Diffusion v1.5 + LoRA) on normal lymph-node patches only; at inference the pathology vision-language model CONCH picks the 5 best-matching of 74 "normal tissue" keywords as a prompt, the input is reconstructed toward normal, and the input–reconstruction difference is the anomaly score (the paper does not name the distance; the released code computes latent-space MSE and pixel LPIPS) — patch AUC 0.9587 on gastric lymph nodes and 0.8884 cross-organ on breast lymph nodes (Camelyon16).
oneliner.zh: AnoPILaD:只用正常淋巴结图块微调一个文本条件的潜空间扩散模型(Stable Diffusion v1.5 + LoRA),推理时用病理视觉-语言模型 CONCH 从 74 个"正常组织关键词"里挑出最贴切的 5 个作为提示,把输入"重建成正常样子",输入与重建的差异就是异常分(论文未说明用哪种距离;公开代码计算潜空间 MSE 和像素级 LPIPS 两种分数);在胃淋巴结上 patch-AUC 0.9587,跨器官到乳腺淋巴结(Camelyon16)仍有 0.8884。

nodes.label: BI histo-AD code
nodes.title: Boehringer-Ingelheim/anomaly-detection-in-histology

oneliner.en: A PyTorch repository from Boehringer Ingelheim: a CNN is trained on healthy tissue from several species, organs and two stains (auxiliary classification + center-loss), then a one-class SVM is fit on healthy features of the target tissue to find drug-induced histological alterations in whole-slide images; companion paper: Zingman et al., *Medical Image Analysis* 2024.
oneliner.zh: Boehringer Ingelheim 的 PyTorch 代码库:先在多物种、多器官、两种染色的健康组织上训练 CNN(辅助分类任务 + center-loss),再在目标组织的健康特征上训练 one-class SVM,用来在全切片中找出药物引起的组织病理改变;配套论文为 Zingman et al., *Medical Image Analysis* 2024。

nodes.label: Pathology FM benchmark
nodes.title: A benchmark study of vision and pathology foundation models for computational pathology

oneliner.en: This Stanford (Gevaert lab) benchmark evaluates 32 foundation models in four categories — general vision (VM), general vision-language (VLM), pathology vision (Path-VM) and pathology vision-language (Path-VLM) — all frozen with only a linear probe trained, on 41 tasks, 53 datasets and >17,500 WSIs. Path-VMs lead but differences among the top models are mostly non-significant, Path-VMs beat Path-VLMs, neither model size nor pretraining data size consistently predicts downstream performance, and majority-vote ensembling improves aggregate performance (Abstract).
oneliner.zh: 这篇 Stanford(Gevaert 组)的 benchmark 把 32 个基础模型分成四类——通用视觉 VM、通用视觉-语言 VLM、病理专用视觉 Path-VM、病理专用视觉-语言 Path-VLM——全部冻结、只训 linear probe,在 41 个任务、53 个数据集、17,500+ 张 WSI 上统一评测:Path-VM 稳居前列但头部模型之间差异多不显著,Path-VM 优于 Path-VLM,模型规模和预训练数据量都不能稳定预测下游表现,多数投票集成在总体上进一步提升(Abstract)。

nodes.label: Linear baselines win
nodes.title: Deep-learning-based gene perturbation effect prediction does not yet outperform simple linear baselines

oneliner.en: For predicting transcriptomic effects of double perturbations and of unseen single perturbations, none of scGPT, scFoundation, GEARS, CPA, or scBERT / Geneformer / UCE with a linear decoder consistently beats "additive", "no change", "mean" or a simple bilinear model; the only consistent winner is a linear model whose perturbation embedding is pretrained on perturbation data from another cell line.
oneliner.zh: 在双扰动与未见单扰动的转录组效应预测上,scGPT、scFoundation、GEARS、CPA 以及接线性解码器的 scBERT / Geneformer / UCE,没有一个稳定超过「加性」「不变」「均值」或一个简单的双线性模型;唯一稳定最好的是在另一细胞系的扰动数据上预训练扰动嵌入的线性模型。

nodes.label: Nephrobase Cell+
nodes.title: Nephrobase Cell+: Multimodal Single-Cell Foundation Model for Decoding Kidney Biology

oneliner.en: The Susztak lab pretrains from scratch the first kidney-specific single-cell foundation model, Nephrobase Cell+ (1B and 500M variants): ~39.5M cells/nuclei, 4,319 samples, four species (human, mouse, rat, pig), scRNA / snRNA / snATAC / CosMx / Xenium, ~100B tokens; an encoder-decoder transformer with MoE and adversarial batch removal. On held-out human (KPMP 2025 Q2) and mouse kidney data it beats Geneformer, scGPT, UCE, PCA and an autoencoder on clustering, batch integration, cross-species alignment and "zero-shot" annotation.
oneliner.zh: Susztak 组从零预训练了首个肾脏专用单细胞基础模型 Nephrobase Cell+(1B 与 500M 两个版本):约 39.5M 个细胞/核、4,319 个样本、四个物种(人、小鼠、大鼠、猪)、scRNA / snRNA / snATAC / CosMx / Xenium 多模态,约 1000 亿 token;encoder-decoder Transformer + MoE + 对抗去批次;在留出的人(KPMP 2025 Q2)与小鼠肾数据上,聚类、批次整合、跨物种对齐与「零样本」注释均优于 Geneformer、scGPT、UCE、PCA 与 autoencoder。

nodes.label: scFM zero-shot limits
nodes.title: Zero-shot evaluation reveals limitations of single-cell foundation models

oneliner.en: Using scGPT and Geneformer cell embeddings zero-shot — no fine-tuning — for cell-type clustering and batch integration, both generally underperform simply selecting HVGs, Harmony and scVI across five datasets; they even struggle at their own pretraining task (masked expression reconstruction) — scGPT without cell embeddings does worse than predicting the mean.
oneliner.zh: 不做任何微调、直接用 scGPT 与 Geneformer 的细胞嵌入做细胞类型聚类与批次整合,它们在五个数据集上普遍不如「选 HVG」、Harmony 与 scVI;连预训练任务本身(掩码表达重建)也做得勉强 —— scGPT 不加细胞嵌入时甚至不如「预测均值」。

nodes.label: Generative histopathology FM
nodes.title: A Generative Foundation Model for Multimodal Histopathology

oneliner.en: MuPAD (Multimodal Pathology Diffusion; spelled MUPAD in the PDF and MuPD on the arXiv abstract page) is a generative pathology foundation model: one diffusion transformer with Decoupled Cross-Attention (DCA) conditions H&E generation on images, RNA pathway scores and clinical text, and a single model covers text/image/RNA→H&E generation, frozen→FFPE translation and H&E→IHC/mIF virtual staining (Abstract).
oneliner.zh: MuPAD(Multimodal Pathology Diffusion;PDF 中写作 MUPAD,arXiv 摘要页写作 MuPD)是一个生成式病理基础模型:用一个带"解耦跨模态注意力"(Decoupled Cross-Attention, DCA)的扩散 Transformer,把 H&E 图像、RNA 通路分数和临床文本放进同一个条件生成框架,一个模型同时做文本/图像/RNA→H&E 生成、冰冻→石蜡切片转换和 H&E→IHC/mIF 虚拟染色(Abstract)。

nodes.label: Nicheformer
nodes.title: Nicheformer: a foundation model for single-cell and spatial omics

oneliner.en: Nicheformer is a 49.3M-parameter transformer foundation model pretrained on SpatialCorpus-110M (57.06M dissociated + 53.8M image-based spatial cells, human and mouse, 73 tissues) with ranked gene tokens plus species/modality/technology context tokens. On newly designed spatial tasks (niche/region labels, neighbourhood composition, neighbourhood density) both linear probing and fine-tuning beat Geneformer, scGPT, UCE, CellPLM, scVI and PCA, and it transfers spatial context onto scRNA-seq.
oneliner.zh: Nicheformer 是一个 49.3M 参数的 Transformer 基础模型,在 SpatialCorpus-110M(57.06M 解离细胞 + 53.8M 成像空间细胞,人和小鼠,73 个组织)上用排序基因 token + 物种/模态/技术上下文 token 预训练;在新设计的空间任务(niche/区域标签、邻域组成、邻域密度)上,linear probing 与微调都优于 Geneformer、scGPT、UCE、CellPLM、scVI、PCA,并能把空间上下文迁移到 scRNA-seq 上。

nodes.label: UNI2-h
nodes.title: MahmoodLab/UNI2-h

oneliner.en: UNI2-h is a pathology vision foundation model from the Mahmood Lab (Harvard / BWH): a 681M-parameter custom ViT-H/14 trained with the DINOv2 recipe on 200M+ H&E and IHC tiles from Mass General Brigham, mapping a 224×224 tissue tile to a 1,536-dim feature for frozen downstream use (model card §"Model Description", §"Training Details").
oneliner.zh: UNI2-h 是 Mahmood Lab(Harvard / BWH)发布的病理视觉基础模型:一个 681M 参数的定制 ViT-H/14,用 DINOv2 配方在 Mass General Brigham 的 2 亿+ 个 H&E 与 IHC 图块上自监督训练,把 224×224 组织图块编码为 1,536 维特征,供下游冻结使用(model card §"Model Description"、§"Training Details")。

nodes.label: HEST-1k
nodes.title: HEST-1k: A Dataset for Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology Image Analysis

oneliner.en: HEST-1k unifies 1,229 spatial-transcriptomics (ST) samples from 153 public and internal cohorts into one format — H&E whole-slide image + aligned spot-level expression + metadata — and ships the HEST-Library Python package and HEST-Benchmark, which scores 11 pathology foundation models on predicting gene expression from H&E patches across 9 tasks (Abstract, §1).
oneliner.zh: HEST-1k 把 153 个公开与内部队列中的 1,229 个空间转录组(ST)样本统一成"H&E 全切片 + 对齐的 spot 表达矩阵 + 元数据"的标准格式,配套 Python 工具包 HEST-Library 和"从 H&E patch 预测基因表达"的 HEST-Benchmark(9 个任务、11 个病理基础模型)(Abstract, §1)。

nodes.label: Virchow
nodes.title: A foundation model for clinical-grade computational pathology and rare cancers detection

oneliner.en: Virchow is a 632M-parameter ViT-H/14 pathology foundation model trained by Paige and Microsoft Research with DINOv2 self-supervision on ~1.5M H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) from MSKCC; an aggregator trained on its frozen tile embeddings performs pan-cancer detection across 16 cancer types with specimen-level AUC 0.950, and 0.937 on the 7 rare cancers (Abstract; Fig. 2b–c).
oneliner.zh: Virchow 是 Paige 与 Microsoft Research 用 DINOv2 自监督在 MSKCC 约 150 万张 H&E 全切片(WSI)上训练的 632M 参数 ViT-H/14 病理基础模型;在它的冻结 tile 嵌入上训练一个聚合器,就能做跨 16 种癌的"泛癌检测",标本级 AUC 0.950,其中 7 种罕见癌 AUC 0.937(Abstract;Fig. 2b–c)。

nodes.label: Pathomics signature
nodes.title: Deep learning-based pathomics signature predicts prognosis and treatment response in gastric cancer: a multicenter retrospective study

oneliner.en: The authors extract features from gastric-cancer H&E whole-slide images with a multi-scale graph neural network plus gated-attention MIL (MS-GMIL), then use LASSO-Cox to pick 11 features into a weighted sum — the pathomics signature PSGC; it is an independent prognostic factor for overall survival in one training and four validation cohorts (3,138 patients), and is used to stratify adjuvant-chemotherapy benefit and infer immunotherapy response.
oneliner.zh: 作者用多尺度图神经网络 + 门控注意力 MIL(MS-GMIL)从胃癌 H&E 全切片提取特征,再用 LASSO-Cox 选出 11 个特征加权求和,得到病理组学签名 PSGC;它在 1 个训练队列和 4 个验证队列(共 3,138 例)中都是总生存的独立预后因素,并被用来分层辅助化疗获益和推测免疫治疗反应。

nodes.label: Pathomics (Blood 2023)
nodes.title: A Deep Learning-Based Pathomics Methodology for Quantifying and Characterizing Nucleated Cells in the Bone Marrow Microenvironment

oneliner.en: On H&E whole-slide images of bone-marrow biopsies from 54 polycythemia vera (PV) patients, the authors segment nucleated cells with deep learning and fat / evaluable regions with classical image analysis to estimate marrow cellularity automatically, comparing with pathology reports; a cell-based estimator agrees far better with the reports than a tissue-area-based one.
oneliner.zh: 在 54 例真性红细胞增多症(PV)患者的骨髓活检 H&E 全切片上,作者用深度学习分割有核细胞、配合经典图像分析分割脂肪和可评估区域,自动估计骨髓"细胞密度"(cellularity),并与病理报告对比;基于细胞计数的方法与报告的一致性明显好于基于组织面积的方法。

nodes.label: PathOmics code
nodes.title: Cassie07/PathOmics

oneliner.en: PathOmics is the official code of the MICCAI 2023 paper (Oral; "top 9%" per the README) "Pathology-and-genomics Multimodal Transformer for Survival Outcome Prediction": unsupervised pretraining fuses pathology-slide and genomics (mRNA expression, copy-number alteration (CNA) or methylation) embeddings, then supervised finetuning predicts cancer survival with either both modalities or a single one.
oneliner.zh: PathOmics 是 MICCAI 2023(Oral,README 称 top 9%)论文 "Pathology-and-genomics Multimodal Transformer for Survival Outcome Prediction" 的官方代码:先用无监督预训练把病理切片和基因组学(mRNA 表达、拷贝数变异 CNA 或甲基化)的嵌入融合对齐,再有监督微调做癌症生存预测,微调时可以用双模态,也可以只用单一模态。

nodes.label: ECG sudden-death biomarker
nodes.title: An ECG biomarker for sudden cardiac death discovered with deep learning

oneliner.en: A deep network trained on all ECGs of a Swedish region linked to death certificates predicts one-year sudden cardiac death (SCD); a generative model guided by the predictor then morphs low-risk beats into high-risk ones to reveal what the model learned — a slurred terminal R wave in lead aVL that the authors say has not been described before (Abstract, Figs. 4–5).
oneliner.zh: 在瑞典一个地区全部 ECG 与死亡证明链接的数据上训练深度网络预测一年内心脏性猝死(SCD),再用一个"预测模型引导的生成模型"把低风险心跳逐步变成高风险心跳,从而看出模型学到的波形特征——aVL 导联 QRS 末端的 R 波"拖尾",作者称此前未被描述(Abstract, Fig. 4–5)。

nodes.label: AI ejection fraction
nodes.title: An artificial intelligence model to detect abnormal ejection fraction from non-contrast chest computed tomography: the CT–LVEF study

oneliner.en: A CT-ViT encoder (3D vision transformer from GenerateCT) classifies left-ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) <50% vs ≥50% from routine non-gated, non-contrast chest CTs acquired for other reasons; AUROC 0.786 at the development site (Columbia) and 0.762 at an external site (Weill Cornell), as opportunistic heart-failure screening (Abstract).
oneliner.zh: 用 GenerateCT 的 CT-ViT 编码器(3D vision transformer)从为其他原因拍的常规、非门控、非增强胸部 CT 判断左室射血分数(LVEF)是否 <50%;在开发医院(Columbia)AUROC 0.786、外部医院(Weill Cornell)0.762,作为心衰的机会性筛查(Abstract)。

nodes.label: MedIAnomaly
nodes.title: MedIAnomaly: A comparative study of anomaly detection in medical images

oneliner.en: Cai, Chen, Cheng et al. (HKUST) build MedIAnomaly, a unified medical-image AD benchmark — 7 datasets, 5 modalities (chest X-ray, brain MRI, fundus, dermoscopy, histopathology), 30 methods — comparing image-level classification and pixel-level segmentation under unified architectures, and dissecting key components one by one (latent size, reconstruction distance, gradient scores, DDPM noise type, ImageNet weights). Headline findings: a plain AE is a strong baseline, ImageNet features are surprisingly strong, and reconstruction quality correlates only weakly with detection performance.
oneliner.zh: HKUST 的 Cai、Chen、Cheng 等搭建了医学图像 anomaly detection 的统一基准 MedIAnomaly:7 个数据集、5 种模态(胸片、脑 MRI、眼底、皮肤镜、病理)、30 种方法,在统一网络结构下比较图像级分类与像素级分割,并逐个拆解关键组件(latent 大小、重建距离函数、梯度分数、DDPM 噪声类型、ImageNet 权重),给出「朴素 AE 是强基线、ImageNet 特征出奇地强、重建质量与检测性能弱相关」等结论。

nodes.label: Abnormality radiology (Ligero 2024)
nodes.title: Abnormality-Driven Representation Learning for Radiology Imaging

oneliner.en: CLEAR treats a CT scan as a stack of 2D axial slices: a frozen encoder trained by self-supervised contrastive learning embeds each slice, and attention-based multiple-instance learning (ABMIL) aggregates them into a patient-level prediction; the proposed LeCL feeds lesion-centred crops to one encoder branch so that representations focus on abnormalities. With 22–36M-parameter models it matches or slightly beats BiomedCLIP on three tasks.
oneliner.zh: CLEAR 框架把 CT 当作一叠 2D 轴位切片:用自监督对比学习训练的编码器(冻结)给每张切片提特征,再用注意力多示例学习(ABMIL)聚合成病人级预测;其中提出的 LeCL 在对比学习中让一路编码器看到以病灶为中心的裁剪,使表征更关注异常。用约 2–4 千万参数的模型,在三项任务上与 BiomedCLIP 相当或略好。

nodes.label: NIH Kidney AI Challenge
nodes.title: Kidney Artificial Intelligence Discovery Challenge: From Nebulae to Nephrons
nodes.venue: NIDDK / NIH (prize challenge, hosted on HeroX)

oneliner.en: A US$100,000 NIDDK prize challenge hosted on HeroX: inspired by astronomy, where AI found rare gravitational lenses and other anomalies in archival telescope images, it asks participants to use only open KPMP Kidney Tissue Atlas data to discover previously unrecognized patterns, objects or anomalies in kidney-biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), backed by human–AI review with pathologists and nephrologists — the goal is discovery, not classification of known disease states.
oneliner.zh: NIDDK 发起、HeroX 承办的 10 万美元奖金挑战赛:借鉴天文学用 AI 在存档望远镜图像中找引力透镜等稀有异常的经验,要求参赛者只用 KPMP Kidney Tissue Atlas 的公开(open)数据,在肾活检全切片图像(WSI)中发现以往未识别的形态模式/对象/异常,并以病理与肾内科专家的人机协同复核来支撑这些发现 —— 目标是"发现",而不是对已知疾病做分类。

nodes.label: Virtual Cell Challenge
nodes.title: Virtual Cell Challenge
nodes.venue: Arc Institute (competition; companion paper in Cell)

oneliner.en: An annual open competition by the Arc Institute: given single-cell expression after CRISPRi knockdown of some genes in a new cell type (H1 human embryonic stem cells in 2025), predict how unseen knockdowns change single-cell expression; framed as "a Turing test for the virtual cell" (*Cell* title; wrap-up heading "The Turing Test for Virtual Cells").
oneliner.zh: Arc Institute 每年举办的公开竞赛:给定一个新细胞类型(2025 届是 H1 人胚胎干细胞)里部分基因被 CRISPRi 敲低后的单细胞表达,预测其余未见过的敲低会让单细胞表达怎样变化;官方把它定位为"virtual cell 的图灵测试"(*Cell* 标题;wrap-up 的小标题 "The Turing Test for Virtual Cells")。

nodes.label: AutoResearch failures
nodes.title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks

oneliner.en: AutoResearchEval runs 8 harness–model combinations on 100 real research tasks derived from frontier papers (7 domains, full lifecycle: ideation → retrieval → execution → analysis → writing → self-review), yielding 800 full trajectories; an agent-as-a-judge that reads every artefact (code, logs, data, reports) annotates them, inducing ARFT, a taxonomy of 45 failure patterns. The conclusion: failures converge on one root cause — agents lack a metacognitive loop (they don't check output against evidence, don't act on problems they find, and don't question the path itself).
oneliner.zh: AutoResearchEval 用 100 个来自前沿论文的真实科研任务(7 个领域、覆盖 ideation → 检索 → 执行 → 分析 → 写作 → 自审全生命周期)跑 8 种 harness–模型组合,得到 800 条完整轨迹;再用读取全部产物(代码、日志、数据、报告)的 agent-as-a-judge 标注,归纳出 45 种失败模式的 ARFT 分类法 —— 结论是所有失败汇聚到一个根因:agent 缺少元认知闭环(不核对产出与证据、发现问题也不修正、不质疑路径本身)。

nodes.label: BiomniBench
nodes.title: BiomniBench: Process-level Evaluation of LLM Agents for Real-world Biomedical Research

oneliner.en: BiomniBench is a process-level benchmark for biomedical agents: instead of scoring only the final answer, an LLM judge grades the agent's full analytical trajectory (trace.md + answer.txt) against expert-written (often original-author-written), task-specific A/B/C rubrics. The first release, BiomniBench-DA, has 100 data-analysis tasks built on the public data of Nature/Cell/Science-tier papers. The best configuration (Claude Code + Opus 4.7) reaches only 73.34/100, and the agent harness moves scores more than a model generation does.
oneliner.zh: BiomniBench 是一个过程级(process-level)的生物医学 agent 基准:不只看最终答案,而是用专家(常为原论文作者)编写的、任务特定的 A/B/C 分级 rubric,由 LLM judge 对 agent 的完整分析轨迹(trace.md + answer.txt)打分;首发 BiomniBench-DA 含 100 个基于 Nature/Cell/Science 级论文公开数据的数据分析任务。最佳配置(Claude Code + Opus 4.7)仅 73.34/100,且 agent harness 对分数的影响大于模型换代。

nodes.label: CellVoyager
nodes.title: CellVoyager: AI CompBio agent generates new insights by autonomously analyzing biological data

oneliner.en: CellVoyager (Zou lab, Stanford) is an agent that autonomously explores scRNA-seq data inside a Jupyter notebook: given a published paper and its data, it extracts which analyses were already done, then generates different hypotheses and analysis plans ("exploration blueprints"), self-critiques, executes code, reads figures with a vision-language model and replans. It beats its base LLMs on CellBench at predicting the analyses authors performed, and in three re-analysis case studies scored by the original authors it surfaced new hypotheses such as elevated pyroptosis scores in CD8+ T cells in COVID-19 and transcriptional noise in the aging SVZ.
oneliner.zh: CellVoyager(Stanford Zou 组)是一个在 Jupyter notebook 里自主探索 scRNA-seq 数据的 agent:输入一篇已发表论文和它的数据,先提取"已做过哪些分析",再生成与之不同的假设与分析计划(exploration blueprint)、自我批评、写代码执行、用视觉语言模型读图、重新规划;在 CellBench 上比底座 LLM 更会"猜作者做了什么分析",在三个真实再分析案例中由原文作者打分,提出了 CD8+ T 细胞 pyroptosis 评分升高、SVZ 衰老与转录噪声等新假设。

nodes.label: Citation faithfulness guard
nodes.title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis

oneliner.en: Literature-synthesis agents like OpenScholar and PaperQA2, and their benchmarks, all check whether citations hold — but nobody audits whether the checker itself is reliable. This paper shows that on identical agent outputs the unsupported-citation rate ranges from ~3% to ~18% depending only on verifier strictness; verifiers agree on what is supported but barely agree on what to flag (negative-specific agreement 0.27–0.30). The authors give a gold-anchored evaluation protocol and a split-conformal guard that places a distribution-free, finite-sample guarantee on the catch rate of truly unsupported citations, and show that whether the guarantee transfers is governed by calibration-negative difficulty.
oneliner.zh: OpenScholar、PaperQA2 这类文献综合 agent 及其基准都会「检查引用是否成立」,但没人审计这个检查器本身是否可靠。本文证明:同一批 agent 输出,仅因 verifier 严格度不同,未支持引用率就在 约 3% 到约 18% 之间变动;verifier 们在「哪些被支持」上一致,在「该标记哪些」上却几乎不一致(negative-specific agreement 0.27–0.30)。作者给出以人工金标准为锚的评估协议 + 一个 split-conformal 守卫,对「漏过标记规则的真正未支持引用」给出无分布、有限样本的捕获率保证,并指出保证能否迁移取决于校准负样本的难度。

nodes.label: Co-Scientist
nodes.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist

oneliner.en: Google's Co-Scientist is a Gemini 2.0–based multi-agent "structured scientific thinking engine": a Supervisor schedules six agent types — Generation, Reflection, Ranking, Proximity, Evolution, Meta-review — over an asynchronous task queue, self-improving hypotheses through "generate–debate–evolve" plus an Elo tournament as test-time compute scales. It is wet-lab validated in three settings: AML drug repurposing (KIRA6 IC50 10 nM in KG-1a, an 18-fold window over a non-AML control), liver-fibrosis epigenetic targets (2 of 3 active in human hepatic organoids) and the bacterial cf-PICI mechanism (an unpublished finding independently recapitulated in 2 days).
oneliner.zh: Google 的 Co-Scientist 是一个基于 Gemini 2.0 的多智能体「结构化科学思考引擎」:Supervisor 在异步任务队列里调度 Generation、Reflection、Ranking、Proximity、Evolution、Meta-review 六类 agent,以「生成–辩论–进化」加 Elo 锦标赛不断扩展 test-time compute 来自我改进假设;在 AML 药物重定位(KIRA6 对 KG-1a 的 IC50 10 nM,较非 AML 对照有 18 倍窗口)、肝纤维化表观靶点(人肝类器官中 2/3 有效)与细菌 cf-PICI 机制(2 天内独立重现未发表发现)三个场景做了湿实验验证。

nodes.label: DeepEvidence
nodes.title: Empowering biomedical evidence exploration and synthesis with deep knowledge graph research

oneliner.en: DeepEvidence is a biomedical deep-research agent: an orchestrator dispatches two kinds of subagent — breadth-first BFRS and depth-first DFRS — that write code to query 17 heterogeneous knowledge bases and the literature, while incrementally building an evidence graph with provenance. With the same base LLM (GPT-5) for every agent, it beats Biomni and ToolUniverse on four open benchmarks and on new drug-discovery, preclinical, clinical-trial and evidence-based-medicine tasks (Abstract; Figs. 1–5).
oneliner.zh: DeepEvidence 是一个面向生物医学的 deep research agent:一个 orchestrator 调度两类子 agent —— 广度优先的 BFRS 和深度优先的 DFRS —— 通过写代码去查 17 个异构知识库与文献,同时增量构建一张带出处(provenance)的 evidence graph;在同一底座 LLM(GPT-5)下,它在 4 个公开基准和一组新建的药物发现、临床前、临床试验、循证医学任务上都超过 Biomni 与 ToolUniverse(Abstract;Fig. 1–5)。

nodes.label: FEV review
nodes.title: Evaluating Agentic Bioinformatics through Function, Evidence, and Validation

oneliner.en: This review takes the inspectable workflow trajectory — not architecture or the final answer — as the unit of analysis and introduces the Function–Evidence–Validation (FEV) framework: Function records the workflow operations an agent demonstrably performs (F1–F6), Evidence the traceable sources supporting actions and claims (E1–E6), and Validation the cumulative assurance reached for a specific use case (V0–V4 plus seven qualifiers). Coding 109 bioinformatics agent/agent-adjacent systems and 28 benchmarks, it finds planning and tool execution advancing fast while replayability, provenance, external and prospective empirical validation lag (most systems at V3, only seven at V4).
oneliner.zh: 这篇综述把「可检视的工作流轨迹」而非架构或最终答案作为分析单元,提出 Function–Evidence–Validation(FEV)框架:Function 记录 agent 实际演示了哪些工作流操作(F1–F6),Evidence 记录支撑动作与论断的可追溯来源(E1–E6),Validation 记录针对具体用例累积达到的保证等级(V0–V4 + 七个限定符);用它编码了 109 个生物信息 agent/近 agent 系统与 28 个基准 —— 规划与工具执行进展快,而可重放、溯源、外部验证与前瞻实验验证明显滞后(绝大多数停在 V3,仅 7 个到 V4)。

nodes.label: LLM-as-judge in healthcare
nodes.title: LLM-as-a-Judge in Healthcare: A Scoping Analysis of Applications, Methods, and Human Alignment

oneliner.en: A PRISMA-guided scoping review: five databases searched for January 2023 – February 2026, 134 healthcare LLM-as-a-Judge studies included and coded by health scenario, judge configuration, technique and validation design. Judge–expert alignment is mostly moderate to strong (median agreement 0.83, median Cohen's κ 0.78, median correlation 0.69) but strongly task-, rubric- and model-dependent, and there are almost no controlled comparisons showing which configuration suits which clinical task.
oneliner.zh: 一篇 PRISMA 指引的范围综述:在 5 个数据库检索 2023-01 至 2026-02 的文献,纳入 134 篇医疗领域 LLM-as-a-Judge 研究,按健康场景、judge 配置、技术路线、验证设计编码;结论是 judge 与专家的一致性多为中到强(一致率中位数 0.83、Cohen's κ 中位数 0.78、相关系数中位数 0.69),但高度依赖任务、rubric 与模型,且几乎没有受控对比研究告诉你哪种配置适合哪种临床任务。

nodes.label: MedRAGChecker
nodes.title: MedRAGChecker: Claim-Level Verification for Biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation

oneliner.en: MedRAGChecker decomposes long-form biomedical RAG answers into atomic claims (SPO triples) and verifies each with a distilled NLI checker plus a knowledge-graph (KG) consistency signal, fusing them via selective gating only when NLI confidently entails while the KG confidently conflicts. The headline finding is that KG coverage decides whether the KG helps or hurts: DRKG (62.7% coverage) inflates the hallucination rate to 34.2%, while BioPortal (94.2% coverage) lowers it to 25.2%.
oneliner.zh: MedRAGChecker 把生物医学 RAG 的长答案拆成原子 claim(SPO 三元组),用「蒸馏出的 NLI 检查器 + 知识图谱(KG)一致性信号」逐条核验,并用 selective gating 只在「NLI 很确信蕴含、KG 很确信冲突」时才融合 KG —— 核心发现是 KG 覆盖率决定 KG 是帮忙还是添乱:覆盖率 62.7% 的 DRKG 把幻觉率推高到 34.2%,覆盖率 94.2% 的 BioPortal 把它压到 25.2%。

nodes.label: PING (trajectory hallucination)
nodes.title: Why Your Deep Research Agent Fails? On Hallucination Evaluation in Full Research Trajectory

oneliner.en: Shifts from final-report evaluation to auditing the whole plan–search–summarize trajectory: the PING taxonomy (Propagation, Intent, Noise-induced, Grounding) classifies deep-research-agent (DRA) hallucinations by locus of failure, an evaluation framework decomposes trajectories into atomic actions/claims/sub-queries, and 100 hallucination-prone queries form DeepHalluBench. None of six DRAs is uniformly low-hallucination; failures trace to hallucination propagation and cognitive biases — the temporal "Anchor Effect" and semantic "Homogeneity Bias".
oneliner.zh: 从「只看最终报告」转向「审计整条 plan–search–summarize 轨迹」:提出 PING 分类法(Propagation 传播、Intent 意图、Noise-induced 噪声、Grounding 落地)把 deep research agent(DRA)的幻觉按失效位置分四类,配套把轨迹拆成原子 action/claim/sub-query 的评估框架,并筛出 100 道高幻觉倾向题构成 DeepHalluBench;六个 DRA 无一在所有维度上都低幻觉,失效可追溯到幻觉传播与「锚定效应」「同质化偏差」等认知偏差。

nodes.label: Robin
nodes.title: A multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery

oneliner.en: FutureHouse's Robin chains literature agents (Crow/Falcon, built on PaperQA2) and a data-analysis agent (Finch) into a lab-in-the-loop cycle: given a disease, it proposes mechanisms, in vitro models and drug candidates; humans run the suggested experiments and upload raw data; Finch runs eight independent analysis trajectories and takes a consensus; Robin updates its hypotheses. For dry AMD it proposed enhancing RPE phagocytosis, found the ROCK inhibitor ripasudil (1.89-fold over DMSO) and KL001, and via RNA-seq uncovered ABCA1 upregulation — all hypotheses, experimental directions, data analyses and data figures in the main text were produced by Robin.
oneliner.zh: FutureHouse 的 Robin 把文献检索 agent(Crow/Falcon,基于 PaperQA2)与数据分析 agent(Finch)串成一个 lab-in-the-loop 闭环:给定疾病,自动提出机制、体外模型与候选药物,人类按其建议做实验并上传原始数据,Finch 跑 8 条独立分析轨迹取共识,Robin 再据此更新假设;在干性 AMD 上,它提出「增强 RPE 吞噬」策略,找到 ROCK 抑制剂 ripasudil(比 DMSO 提升 1.89 倍)与 KL001,并经 RNA-seq 发现 ABCA1 上调——正文所有假设、实验方向、数据分析与数据图均由 Robin 产生。

nodes.label: RQ-Bench
nodes.title: On the Limits of LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Novelty Assessment

oneliner.en: RQ-Bench reconstructs 1,434 "author-anchored" research questions (RQs) from 746 recent arXiv CS papers and uses them to test whether LLM-as-judge can reliably assess scientific novelty: LLM judges consistently rate model-generated RQs as more novel (a "novelty mirage"), and side-by-side comparison amplifies the preference — but domain experts reach the opposite conclusion and prefer the author RQs, with human–LLM agreement as low as 22%.
oneliner.zh: RQ-Bench 用 746 篇近期 arXiv CS 论文重建出 1,434 个「作者锚定」的研究问题(RQ),拿来检验 LLM-as-judge 判断科研新颖性是否可靠:LLM 评委一致认为模型生成的 RQ 更新颖(「novelty mirage」),且并排比较时偏好被放大;而领域专家结论相反,更偏好作者原问题 —— 人机一致率低至 22%。

nodes.label: Same patient, different order
nodes.title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs

oneliner.en: The authors propose a "same-input rerun" protocol: replay each MedAgentBench task five times with patient and all inputs fixed, and compare not the score but the orders (FHIR write requests) the agent actually issues. Action-level divergence is pervasive and often invisible to the benchmark's verdict: for Llama-3.1-8B at temperature 0.7, all 43 ordering groups emit a different order set across five identical runs, yet in 22 of them the benchmark reports the same verdict.
oneliner.zh: 作者提出「same-input rerun」协议:在 MedAgentBench 上把同一任务、同一患者、全部输入固定重跑 5 次,比较的不是分数而是 agent 实际下达的医嘱(FHIR 写请求)—— 结果显示动作层面的分歧普遍存在且常常不被 benchmark 的判分记录:Llama-3.1-8B 在 0.7 温度下 43/43 个下单任务组每次下达的医嘱集合都不同,其中 22 组的 benchmark 判定却完全相同。

nodes.label: scBench
nodes.title: scBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis

oneliner.en: scBench (LatchBio) is 394 deterministically graded scRNA-seq analysis problems: each gives a real data snapshot taken just before an analysis step, a natural-language task and a grader, across 6 sequencing platforms × 7 task categories. Eight frontier models under one harness reach only 29–53%, and platform matters as much as model (40+ pp drops on less-documented platforms).
oneliner.zh: scBench(LatchBio)是 394 道可确定性判分的 scRNA-seq 分析题:每题给出"某个分析步骤之前"的真实数据快照 + 自然语言任务 + 判分器,覆盖 6 个测序平台 × 7 类任务;8 个前沿模型在同一 harness 下准确率仅 29–53%,且平台差异与模型差异一样大(冷门平台掉 40+ 个百分点)。

nodes.label: scBench-Long
nodes.title: scBench-Long: Verifiable Benchmarking of Long-Horizon Single-Cell Biology

oneliner.en: scBench-Long (LatchBio) moves scBench from single steps to long horizons: 21 evaluations across 5 study systems in which agents start from raw or near-raw single-cell data, with no prescribed method, and must recover a specific scientific conclusion, graded deterministically over controlled vocabularies with companion trajectory rubrics for diagnosis. Across 1,068 trajectories the best model–harness pair (Claude Opus 4.8 + Claude Code) passes only 16/63 (25.4%), and failures are mostly scientific-reasoning failures, not tool-use failures.
oneliner.zh: scBench-Long(LatchBio)把 scBench 从"单步"推进到"长程":21 个评测、5 个研究系统,要求 agent 从原始或接近原始的单细胞数据出发、不给方法地恢复一个具体的科学结论,结论用受控词表确定性判分,另配轨迹 rubric 做诊断;1,068 条轨迹中最强的模型-harness 组合(Claude Opus 4.8 + Claude Code)也只通过 16/63(25.4%),且失败主要不是工具使用失败,而是科学推理失败。

nodes.label: SciRIGOR
nodes.title: SCIRIGOR:Evaluating Open-Ended Scientific Analysis Beyond Final Scores

oneliner.en: SciRigor reconstructs a scientific-analysis agent's outputs (code, structured results, a figure, atomic claims) as a typed evidence graph, requires every primary claim to keep a complete, same-run verifiable "data → transform → result → visual/claim" support path, scores it by weakest link and localises the earliest broken edge. On 100 figure-level cases from Nature and other journals, agents' claims agree with their own results at nearly the same rate whether those results are right or wrong (91.8% vs 91.0%), and the best system achieves only 18.0% strict whole-chain success.
oneliner.zh: SciRigor 把科研分析 agent 的产出(代码、结构化结果、图、原子论断)重建为一张类型化证据图,要求每条主要论断都有一条在同一次运行中可验证的「数据→变换→结果→图/论断」完整支撑路径,并按 weakest-link 打分、定位最早断裂的边;在 100 个来自 Nature 等期刊的图级案例上,agent 的论断与自身结果一致率几乎与结果是否正确无关(91.8% vs 91.0%),最好的系统 strict 全链成功率仅 18.0%。

nodes.label: Who is to blame? (citations)
nodes.title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research

oneliner.en: In multi-agent deep-research (DR) systems information passes through agents like a "telephone game", and both content and citations can be corrupted along the way. This paper locally tests each agent invocation for faithfulness and verifiability relative to its own inputs, so every citation error in the final report can be traced to the agent that introduced it, and typed into four classes (hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, insufficient citations). In Nvidia AI-Q, 84.7% of final-report errors originate at the orchestrator; two simple interventions guided by this raise citation recall by ~5 points without hurting quality.
oneliner.zh: 多智能体 deep research(DR)系统里,信息像「传话游戏」一样逐层传递,内容和引用都会在途中被损坏。本文提出局部测试每一次 agent 调用相对其自身输入的忠实性与可验证性,从而把最终报告里的每个引用错误追溯到引入它的那个 agent,并按四类分型(幻觉、依赖未引用输入、输出无引用、引用不足);在 Nvidia AI-Q 上 84.7% 的最终报告错误源自 orchestrator,据此做的两个简单干预使引用召回率提升约 5 个百分点且不损失质量。

nodes.label: ABC checklist
nodes.title: Establishing Best Practices for Building Rigorous Agentic Benchmarks

oneliner.en: The authors split "can this agentic-benchmark score be trusted" into two conditions — task validity (task success ⇔ the target capability) and outcome validity (a positive evaluation ⇔ genuine task success) — and turn them into an actionable Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC). Auditing ten popular agentic benchmarks with it, they find 7 violate outcome validity, 7 violate task validity, and all 10 have reporting gaps, with estimation errors of up to 100% in relative terms.
oneliner.zh: 作者把 agent 基准「分数可信」拆成两个条件 —— task validity(任务成功 ⇔ 具备目标能力)与 outcome validity(评测判定为成功 ⇔ 任务真的成功)—— 并据此写出一份可操作的 Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC);用它审查 10 个主流 agent 基准,发现 7 个违反 outcome validity、7 个违反 task validity、10 个全部在结果报告上有缺陷,误差最高可达相对 100%。

nodes.label: AILuminate
nodes.title: AILuminate: Introducing v1.0 of the AI Risk and Reliability Benchmark from MLCommons

oneliner.en: AILuminate v1.0 is an industry-standard AI-safety benchmark built through an open process by the MLCommons AI Risk and Reliability working group (with the AI Verify Foundation): an assessment standard (12 hazard categories), 24,000 English prompts (practice + hidden official sets), an ensemble evaluator of fine-tuned guard models with entropy-based tunable thresholds, five-tier grading relative to a "reference system" (Poor → Excellent), and the technical and organizational infrastructure for long-term operation.
